panel.title: Side chat
panel.emptyState:
Drop side questions here while your agent works.
Ask mode advises only; Execute mode may use tools (/side jumps straight there); /fork clones the conversation.
Follow-ups continue the same thread; answers never touch the main session.
panel.modeAskA11y: Ask mode: advice only, no tools
panel.modeWorkA11y: Execute mode: follows the session's mode and may use tools
panel.clearA11y: Archive the current side thread and clear its Q&A
panel.openThreadA11y: Open this side thread in a tab

commands.btwDescription: Side question answered from the current session's context; nothing is sent to the agent
commands.sideDescription: Side task with tools, based on the current session's context; nothing is sent to the agent
commands.forkDescription: Fork this chat: clone the conversation into a parallel session; the original is untouched
commands.forkIntro: Below is the full transcript of "{{title}}", the session you are continuing. It keeps running on its own and neither session affects the other.

errors.tooManyRunning: Too many btw questions are running, try again shortly
errors.mainGone: The main session no longer exists or is unavailable
errors.noWorkspace: The main session has no workspace, so no side thread can be created
errors.threadGone: The target thread has ended; release the reply lock or ask again
errors.permissionWork: The side thread is waiting for permission approval. Handle its permission request in Paseo, then ask again
errors.permissionAdvice: The side thread was asked for permission (it should use no tools); giving up

settings.appearanceInfo: How answers render inside the BTW panel, applied live
settings.previewMarkdown:
### Heading style
Body text can have **bold**, ==highlight==, and `inline code`.
- List item with **bold**
- List item with ==highlight==
settings.lifecycleInfo: A btw thread is one continuous multi-turn conversation
settings.attachSwitch: Attach threads to the main session
settings.attachHint: Threads live as subagents of the main session and are archived with it; they stay usable across plugin reloads. When off, threads are reclaimed on reload
settings.autoArchiveHint: When off, threads are kept until you clear them or the plugin reloads
settings.contextInfo: New threads read the main session's recent messages as background
settings.contextMessagesHint: An integer between {{range}}; very long messages are capped separately
